newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bank profits seen unhurt by higher rates.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bank profits seen unhurt by higher rates.

text.p: If the Federal Reserve raises short term U.S. interest rates as expected on Tuesday, the impact on U.S. banking profits would be minimal to none, analysts said.

"I would argue that a Fed fine tuning should be viewed as positive," said Ruchi Madan, analyst at Prudential Securities. She said a small rise in rates would only prolong an economic environment which is close to "perfect" and which has helped buoy bank profits.
Madan and other analysts said nevertheless that there is a perception in the minds of some investors that rate increases are bad for banks and the stocks sometimes fall in reaction.
